column1: # Review E's rename table (REPORT §2.3.3, API_1.0.md §3.4 "Core methods (E)") as rewrite rules.  Hand-written; edit freely.
# Columns: id, shape, old, new, extra, units, note
#   shape   method        `.old(` -> `.new(`   (and `Type::old(` when written as a path call)
#           path:<Type>   `<Type>::old(` -> `<Type>::new(`   (only with that type written before `::`)
#           flag          `.old(true)` -> `.<extra>()`, `.old(false)` -> `.new()`; anything but a literal is listed
#           manual        found and listed, never rewritten
#   units   same = the 31 unit copies of the method get the same new name;
#           keep = the unit copies keep the old name at 1.0 (policy X): the rule refuses in a file that uses units;
#           -    = no unit type has a method of this name
